name: Edmund Koss

Immanuel Lutheran Church, Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada

notes: Edmund was a cousin to Oscar Zelmer & lived with the Zelmer family @@ 445 Seymour St. He was a co-founder of the cottage @@ Brereton Lake.He died suddenly of a h/attack following surgery for hernia.See Brookside cert.24771.On Jan 14/56 ADZ visited the WPG F.Press archives & obtained a copy of the obit which appd in the WPG FP on Aug 10, 1949.  Allan Zelmer contacted Rev. W.Russell ofRussel MB. in Apr'98 only to find that church records prior 1911 were burned in a Church fire in that year and there is little hope of obtaining exact birthdate
